summary: Learn to map referrals, strengthen client safeguards and monitor financial inclusion linkages. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Financial inclusion and social protection linkages connect social assistance pathways with suitable financial services through referrals and follow-up. For programme officers, financial inclusion specialists and monitoring staff, this course covers mapping referral journeys and partner responsibilities, assessing access and client-protection needs, and creating indicators and a monitoring plan to track whether those connections work.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who coordinate social protection services with financial inclusion providers, track programme results or oversee referrals. It suits people who need to make service connections practical, monitor whether referrals work and raise client-protection concerns through an identifiable reporting chain.
modules: ILO Social Protection Floors and Inclusion
prerequisites: Prior experience in social protection, financial inclusion, programme monitoring or related service coordination is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Participants should be comfortable reviewing programme processes and basic indicators.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
